name: AM
detailed_description:
The twisting roads seem to go on forever. Music blares to fend off the silence, and the only thing keeping you from slamming into the guardrail is a lukewarm gas station coffee. On nights like these, it’s important to ask yourself... what makes you so sure you’re alone?

Hop into the driver’s seat and prepare for anything as you navigate a vast network of rural roads in search of salvation. AM is a high-speed horror game that will keep you on the edge of your seat (and your foot on the gas) as you try to keep the horrors lurking in this abandoned world in your rearview.

Drive through an "abandoned" world.

Navigate miles of winding U.S. backroads from the driver’s seat of your beat-up hooptie. This isn’t a sports car—you’ll feel every bump, every skid, and every struggle to keep control on these twisting mountain roads. You don’t know where the exit is, but anywhere is better than here. With no GPS to guide you, you’ll have to find your own way. But don’t worry—you won’t be alone.

Use light to defend yourself from the dark.

Your only defense against whatever is trying to break into your car is a flashlight—but these aren’t normal intruders, and this isn’t a normal flashlight. Charge it by harnessing the holy power of your Jesus stickers, then unleash a divine blast on anything that dares invade your personal space.

CHECK OUT THE DEMO TO EXPERIENCE THE FIRST CHAPTER OF AM

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit version
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1080 or equivalent
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit version
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 2080 or equivalent
  • Storage: 2 MB available space

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains scenes of gore and features moments some players may find disturbing.
